utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ve got Maple at 9 by the community center lot, and I’m bringing a few small tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Bo — I’ve been telling folks the repair drive’s at the community center lot, and Eli should have the schedule sorted this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I've got Maple at 9 at the community center lot, so I’ll just stick with that unless Eli says otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye — quick update: the repair drive’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, so if you’re still able to help, I’d love to add you to the volunteer list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work for me as long as I stay clear of school pickup and drop-off times, so yes, add me to the list for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Faye—thanks for making it work; I’ll put you down for Sunday at the community center and keep your school pickup and drop-off window clear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, Sam—I've got the gloves, and I’m supposed to check the shed for that ladder and a couple of hammers; if I blank on it, please give me a nudge.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Oren—I’ll remind you about the ladder and hammers, and I’ll keep sorting the donated tools in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam—I appreciate the nudge; I’ll swing by with the gloves for sure and check the shed for that ladder and those hammers before I forget.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hi Noah — we’ve got about seven volunteers lined up across both blocks, and the biggest needs are still bike tune-ups plus someone steady at the tool table by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—thanks, Jules. I’ll aim for the tool table at 10 on Saturday if that still helps, but honestly I may need a reminder.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That helps a lot, Noah—I’ll count you in for the tool table at 10 and I’ll send you a reminder Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It starts at 10 on Saturday at the community center, Ira, and we’d be glad to have you if you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mara—that helps a lot. I’m still out on errands, but I’ll check the signup list when Eli sends it and see if I can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Ira—no pressure, and even stopping by for a little while helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo, the repair drive’s really picking up—if you’ve got any repair needs or spare parts, send them over this afternoon and I’ll spread the word to a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—send any spare parts to the shed this afternoon, and I’ll keep repair requests organized for intake at 9.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Leo—I’ll let folks know to bring spare parts by the shed this afternoon, and I’ll spread the word fast so your intake at 9 stays smooth.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Rosa’s got the full list, but I know I’m still covering the early quiet check-in for a little while, and there’ll be the usual small repairs like lamps, toasters, and bikes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks—if Rosa’s got the list, I’ll check with her and then jump in wherever the intake’s backing up most.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Nell, I heard the repair drive’s really coming together—people have been dropping off tools, and Mara’s bringing a box of screws later too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds promising—I’ve only heard bits secondhand, but Rosa’s gathering repair needs now, so if you’ve got anything to add I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s perfect—could you tell Rosa Eli said a clear schedule and a list of fixes would help keep things organized?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus, do you know if it’s still just three houses confirmed, and who’s locking down the drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Last I heard, we’ve got three houses confirmed, and Saturday morning at the community center is the drop-off spot we’ve been working with. I’m still planning to bring my toolbox and help get things set up there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, three so far—who’s keeping the sign-in sheet at the community center so we don’t lose track of anything?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hana, I’m sorting the signup list now, and I’ll have a clear repair schedule ready this afternoon so everyone knows where to go.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli—before we move ahead, can you confirm which houses are definitely signed up and exactly what supplies we still need?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still finalizing the signup list, Hana, so I can confirm the houses this afternoon; for now, we still need a clear tally on basic tools, spare parts, and cleaning supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve only heard back from three houses so far, but I can check with a couple more this evening.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey—that helps; we’re still looking for a sturdy ladder and a couple of hammers, so let me know what you hear this evening.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—I’ll ask around tonight and let you know if anyone can lend a ladder or a couple of hammers.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Kira, I’ve got the repair drive marked at the school parking lot after drop-off for now, but I’m still waiting on final confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm Eli’s definitely organizing it and that the school parking lot is the final meetup before we count on it?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can’t confirm either one as final yet—I still have Eli unconfirmed, and the school parking lot is only the placeholder until I get the double-check.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve only heard back from three houses so far, but I’m checking with a couple more this evening.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That helps—I’ve been telling folks the repair drive’s set up by the community center, and Eli should have the schedule sorted this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good to know—I've only heard the basics so far, but Saturday at 10 sounds right. If I learn of a few more houses tonight, I’ll pass that along to Mina.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in and bringing small tools—last I’ve got is Maple at 9, so I’m heading there unless they’ve shifted it again.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—I'm set for the community shed at 9 to take intake, unless Maple’s shifted and you need me there instead.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’d stick with the shed for now—I’ve still got Maple at 9 on my end, so if they changed it again, I’m probably the one who missed the memo.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Noah, can you confirm Eli’s definitely organizing it and where we’re meeting before I count on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I know it starts at 10 on Saturday at the community center, but I can’t honestly confirm Eli’s organizing it—I should double-check before you count on me for that detail.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, thanks—can you double-check who’s organizing it and let me know once that’s confirmed before I rely on the plan?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Opal, I just need the basics nailed down first—who’s handling intake, and exactly where is the drop-off table going?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: For now I’ve got the drop-off table marked at the school parking lot after drop-off, and I’m still waiting on Faye’s confirmation; intake isn’t finalized yet, but I’ll pin that down next.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, that helps, but I’m still hesitant until Faye confirms and we know exactly who’s checking things in so nothing gets lost.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Any update from Eli on the signup list or meetup spot? I’m still out on errands, but I can help once I’m done.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I haven’t heard from Eli yet, but I’m planning to be at the community center Saturday morning to sort the donated tools before check-in. Once you’re back, you can jump in there with me if that still works.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That works for me—if Eli confirms the spot, I’ll plan to meet you at the community center once I’m done with errands. Keep me posted if the signup list comes through.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rosa, we’re still short a sturdy ladder and a couple of hammers, but gloves should be covered if Oren remembers to bring them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo—that helps a lot. I’ll note the ladder and hammers as priorities, and since we’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, I’ll also check in with Oren about the gloves.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—Sunday at the community center works, and I’ll keep tracking the ladder and hammers on my end in case anyone offers them up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we move ahead, can you confirm which Oak house signed up and the exact counts we still need for gloves, trash bags, and tool kits?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can’t confirm exact counts or which Oak house yet, Hana—I’ve just been spreading the word, but I can check with Rosa and get you the right details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn—please check with Rosa first, and once you have the exact Oak house and supply counts, we can decide the next step.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits so far, but Rosa’s gathering repair needs now—if Gus has something to add, I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Tell Rosa it’s shaping up well—I’m bringing my toolbox and ladder Saturday morning to help with the small fixes at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great, Gus—I’ll pass along that you’re bringing your toolbox and ladder Saturday morning to help with the small fixes at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli, we’ve got about four volunteers from our block and three from the next one so far, and most folks are asking for bike tune-ups, small appliance fixes, and a couple of chair repairs.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a solid start, Jules. I’ll slot those jobs into the schedule this afternoon so we can match the volunteers up cleanly and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Eli—if you leave a little room for a couple more bike helpers and someone steady at the tool table, I can keep checking with folks from both blocks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Leo, I heard the repair drive’s really gathering momentum—people have been dropping off tools and spare parts, and Mara’s meant to bring a box of screws later.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—have Mara drop the screws at the shed, and if you can, start grouping the tools and parts so intake goes faster at 9.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely, Leo—I’ll have Mara leave the screws at the shed, and I’ll start sorting the tools and parts so we’re ready by 9.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive anytime outside about 7:30–8:30 in the morning and 2:30–3:30 in the afternoon, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, Faye—thanks; I’ll aim for a time outside those windows and bring the gloves while I check on that ladder.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Oren—I should be free after drop-off, and I can double-check whether they’re staging in the school parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It starts at 10 on Saturday at the community center, Mina, and we’d be glad to have you if you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can make it, but who’s owning intake, and where exactly is the drop-off table going so we can lock this down?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m owning intake, and we’ll set the drop-off table right by the community center entrance so folks see it as they come in.
